notes: All programme pages of the HKUST Program and Course Catalog for 2027/28 entry (taught MSc/MA/MEng/MPM/MPP/MBA/EMBA and combined PGD pages) were collected; DBA programmes skipped as doctoral. HKUST states no separate requirement or minimum mark for Mainland China degree holders, so china_requirement is left out. TOEFL iBT has two scales (80 for tests before 21 Jan 2026, 4.5 from 21 Jan 2026), so no numeric TOEFL value is reported, only the quote. Deadlines are non-local applicant deadlines not yet passed on 2026-10-29; MBA/EMBA/Global Finance pages state no deadline.
